prompt: Create a new agent project named `support-bot` in the current directory. checks.why: per-user OIDC callers are the jwt auth policy
never create a git repository without being asked

reference: `graph-agents-cli create support-bot --runtime langgraph-server --deployment-target kubernetes --checkpointer postgres --registry harbor.acme.internal/agents --cd argocd --auth-policy jwt --model-provider anthropic --agent-guidance-filename CLAUDE.md -y` (no mkdir first, no install, no git init).
